provenance: HAND-WRITTEN, not recorded by Atlas: no SEC, GLEIF or OpenFIGI request was made from tests or while writing them. Values come from the trimmed live responses quoted in docs/research/identity-apis.md (branch research/identity-apis, 5aba8ee; live calls of 2026-09-29) and docs/research/seed-list.md (branch research/seed-list), in the shapes the providers document (SEC: https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-search-assistance/accessing-edgar-data; GLEIF JSON:API: https://api.gleif.org/docs; OpenFIGI: https://www.openfigi.com/api/documentation).
